target: doctor.sh forge section (gitlab) — a transport error or a 5xx is [WARN], never [FAIL]
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" transport-error; fx_reqs_clear; fx_doctor
fx_sec_has transport_warn '\[WARN\]'; fx_sec_has transport_fail '\[FAIL\]'
echo "transport_reached=$(fx_reqs | grep -c '/api/v4/user auth=present')"
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 500 '{}'; fx_reqs_clear; fx_doctor
fx_sec_has s500_warn '\[WARN\]'; fx_sec_has s500_fail '\[FAIL\]'
echo "s500_reached=$(fx_reqs | grep -c '/api/v4/user auth=present')"
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 503 '{}'; fx_doctor
fx_sec_has s503_warn '\[WARN\]'; fx_sec_has s503_fail '\[FAIL\]'
fx_done
